''See also: [[Bellowing Horror Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Bellowing Horror, also referred to as a Bellows or [[Shuffles]], is a small creature described as a spawn of [[Othaghor]]. Physically, it resembles a stout, foot-tall man with undersized bat wings and eyes that convey intense hatred. Its head is a chaotic collection of mouths, eyes, waving stalks, and bone cages that house pulsing organs. Despite its unsettling appearance and the fact that it uses a voice of doom to repeat the most disturbing or vile parts of conversations to unnerve people, it is considered harmless. In some instances, it has been kept as a pet on ships, where it feeds on rats and emits low vibrations similar to a purr or growl.}}
